fix: Navigator::routes() returns an owned Vec<Route> clone of the whole stack, and is_first and is_active (lines 96-100) do the same. Add a borrowing accessor in navigator.rs, e.g. pub(crate) fn with_routes<R>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&[Route]) -> R) -> R { f(&self.state.borrow().routes) }, then: self.navigator.with_routes(|routes| routes.first().is_some_and(|first| first.id == self.route.id)) and self.navigator.with_routes(|routes| routes.iter().any(|route| route.id == self.route.id)). navigator.rs is outside this unit; the fix needs that change too.

Navigator::current() returns an owned Route clone (name and settings allocate) only to compare an id. Use the borrowing accessor suggested for is_first (pub(crate) fn with_routes in navigator.rs): self.navigator.with_routes(|routes| routes.last().is_some_and(|current| current.id == self.route.id)).
